ATL AP Pickup Reference
Domestic Pickup — LN1 Level
From baggage claim → escalator down to lower level (LN1). Driver meets near lower level elevator between doors N2 and N3.
International Pickup — Concourse F
Domestic Terminal International Arrivals. After customs, follow signs to Ground Transportation. Driver waits at curbside pick-up area.
⚠️ Disregard Uber/Lyft rideshare signs
NWDA drivers park in short-term or cell phone lot. Text client when you arrive.

Income
i
Uber, Lyft, or a private client outside the app — log it here so your income & mileage stay complete. Know the split? Add fare/tip/fee detail so your year-end report separates fares from tips instead of lumping it all together.
i
Tick nothing for the complete Year-End P&L — that's the one for taxes: cash basis, both mileage-deduction options, mapped to Schedule C. Tick a payment type and you get a business report instead — same detail, filtered, clearly marked as not for filing. Choose Excel (live formulas, unbranded) or a branded PDF.
i
Respects the “Paid by” filter above. Choose a plain CSV, or a branded PDF with your logo & business name.
i
Snap a photo of every receipt and tag it — fuel, maintenance, tolls, parking. Tolls & parking are deductible on top of your mileage, and easy money to lose if you don't log them.

👋 Welcome! Let's set you up

Why we need this: Your home address helps dispatch find the closest available driver for a ride. Your vehicle info shows on your driver card. Your Venmo and payment options let clients pay you easily. You can change any of this later in your profile — this just gets you started fast.
The name clients see in your confirmation texts and contact card — e.g. if you go by a nickname (Kathleen → Kat). Leave blank to use your full name.
Everyone starts with a shared temporary password. Set your own private one now, or keep the current one for now (you can change it later in your profile).
Used to find the closest available driver when dispatching a ride. You can add it later.
MPG & gas price are only used to calculate your fuel cost on the income page. Skip them if you’re not tracking profit.
+ Add a second vehicle
Second vehicle
The headshot + this vehicle’s photo. Sent to clients when you use this vehicle.
Lets clients pay you with one tap. Add it now or anytime later in your profile.
Your business name & logo appear on receipts clients can download for reimbursement. Leave blank to use NWDA + your name.

Booking your own clients?
Some drivers keep their own client list and want a personal link clients can use to request rides directly. If you'd rather just drive and never deal with that, say no — nothing about it will show up in your app.
⏰ Auto-add surcharges
Pick which surcharges get suggested automatically from a ride’s date & time on rides you schedule. Turning one off only stops the auto-suggestion — you can still add it to any ride by hand. Only admins set the dollar amounts; change this anytime in Profile & Settings.
The message clients get when their ride is confirmed. Set one per ride type, or just a general default.
Already have a message you send?
Paste it and we’ll turn the parts that change every ride into tokens automatically — no need to learn the placeholders.
Placeholders {client} {date} {time} {pickup} {dropoff} {driver} {me} {amount} {flight} {terminal} {phone} fill in automatically.

Change Venmo username

⚠️ Enter your Venmo username exactly as it is spelled on your Venmo profile — uppercase letters and all. Capitalization matters: Kathleen-Herringdine works, but kathleen-herringdine splits the payment. Tap Test to open Venmo and confirm it goes to one person before saving.

📲 Add NWDA to your home screen
This puts the NWDA icon on your phone so the app opens full-screen, just like a regular app.
🍎 iPhone & iPad (use Safari)
1
Open this page in Safari. (It won't work from Chrome or a link inside another app.)
2
Tap the Share button — at the bottom of the screen on iPhone (top-right on iPad).
3
Scroll down the share list and tap Add to Home Screen ⊞.
4
Tap Add in the top-right corner.
5
Close Safari and open the new NWDA icon from your home screen. Done!
🤖 Android (use Chrome)
1
Tap the ⋮ menu in the top-right of Chrome.
2
Tap Add to Home screen (or Install app).
3
Tap Install / Add to confirm.
